content.value: Define skew line. Find the shortest distance between the lines (15) $\begin{array} { r } { \frac { x - 3 } { 3 } = \frac { y - 8 } { - 1 } = \frac { z - 3 } { 1 } , \frac { x + 3 } { - 3 } = \frac { y + 7 } { 2 } = \frac { z - 6 } { 4 } } \end{array}$ . Find also equation and the points in which it meets the given lines.
